title: $900 PS5 Pro Sold Out in US Amid GTA 6 Fever
description: Sony's PS5 Pro is selling out in the US due to GTA 6 fever, with third-party sellers charging up to $1,300 despite ongoing hardware protests.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## $900 PS5 Pro Sells Out in US Amid Massive GTA 6 Fever

No disc drive, no buy? For many players gearing up for the biggest entertainment release in history, that sentiment is being severely tested. According to a recent report by gaming outlet Push Square, Sony’s supercharged PS5 Pro hardware model is currently selling out across the United States as undeniable **GTA 6 fever** takes a firm hold of the gaming community.

### The Power of GTA 6 Overrides Hardware Protests

This surge in demand is particularly noteworthy given the current market climate. Prior to this buying frenzy, frustrated fans had mobilised to stage an ongoing blackout protest against PlayStation hardware. The community movement saw players vowing to keep their consoles unplugged indefinitely in response to various hardware and pricing policies.

However, the gravitational pull of Rockstar Games' upcoming epic has proven too strong for widespread boycotts to maintain momentum. Such is the intense demand for the PS5’s most powerful model—widely expected to be the definitive console experience for exploring Vice City—that players are rushing to secure the hardware anyway.

### Scalpers Capitalize as Prices Reach $1,300

With official retail stock drying up rapidly, the secondary market has exploded. Third-party sellers on platforms like Amazon are taking full advantage of the shortage, charging as much as **$1,300** for the device.

When compared to its official **$900 MSRP**, this represents a massive, staggering mark-up. Yet, the willingness of desperate consumers to pay these inflated prices highlights just how intense the urgency is to secure top-tier hardware ahead of the game's launch.

### Editor's Take

The rapid sell-out of the $900 PS5 Pro proves that when it comes to a cultural phenomenon like GTA 6, traditional consumer pushback and hardware debates take a back seat to performance. Players are willing to pay a premium to ensure they have the absolute best setup ready for launch day, cementing Rockstar's immense influence over the gaming hardware market.
